name: refactor_duplicate_controller_logic
description: Extracts duplicated inline validation from two registration endpoints
prompts: In this Maven Spring Boot project, RegistrationController (src/main/java/com/optarena/registration/RegistrationController.java) has two endpoints, POST /register and POST /register/admin, that each inline the exact same validation logic (username must not be blank, password must be at least 8 characters) before returning a role-specific result. Refactor the controller to extract that duplicated validation into a single shared private helper method used by both handlers, removing the duplication. The externally observable behavior (status codes, response bodies, and the 'USER' vs 'ADMIN' role difference) must stay exactly the same.

test_setup_files.test_register.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['mvn', '-o', '-q', 'package', '-DskipTests'], check=True)
jars = [j for j in glob.glob('target/*.jar') if not j.endswith('.original')]
assert jars, 'no runnable jar produced under target/'
srv = subprocess.Popen(['java', '-jar', jars[0], '--server.port=8066'])

def post(path, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f'http://127.0.0.1:8066{path}', data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    return req

def wait_ready():
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(post('/register', {'username': 'x', 'password': 'longenough1'}), timeout=1)
            return True
        except urllib.error.HTTPError:
            return True
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

def expect_status(req, want):
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=2)
        got = resp.status
        body = json.loads(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        got = e.code
        body = json.loads(e.read())
    assert got == want, f'expected {want}, got {got} (body={body!r})'
    return body

try:
    assert wait_ready(), 'server never became reachable on :8066'

    body = expect_status(post('/register', {'username': 'bob', 'password': 'longenough1'}), 201)
    assert body.get('role') == 'USER', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'

    expect_status(post('/register', {'username': '', 'password': 'longenough1'}), 400)
    expect_status(post('/register', {'username': 'bob', 'password': 'short'}), 400)

    body = expect_status(post('/register/admin', {'username': 'alice', 'password': 'longenough1'}), 201)
    assert body.get('role') == 'ADMIN', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'

    expect_status(post('/register/admin', {'username': 'alice', 'password': 'short'}), 400)
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=10)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()

source = open('src/main/java/com/optarena/registration/RegistrationController.java', encoding='utf-8').read()
occurrences = source.count('isBlank()')
assert occurrences <= 1, f'duplicated validation logic (\"isBlank()\") still appears {occurrences} times across both endpoints - it must be extracted into one shared helper, not copy-pasted'
print('PASS')
